Effect of SS-31 supplementation on metabolome in aged oocytes

Effect of SS-31 supplementation on metabolome in aged oocytes. A Orthogonal partial least squares discriminant analysis (OPLS-DA) of oocytes from aged mice. Red circles represent samples from aged oocytes (n = 7), and green circles represent samples from SS-31 + aged oocytes (n = 6). B Volcano plot showing differential metabolites in SS-31 + aged oocytes compared with aged ones. C KEGG enrichment analysis of differential metabolites in SS-31 + aged oocytes compared with aged ones. D Heatmap illustration showing differential metabolites in the Beta-alanine metabolism pathway in SS-31 + aged oocytes compared with aged ones. E Heatmap illustration showing differential metabolites in the arginine and proline metabolism pathway in SS-31 + aged oocytes compared with aged ones. F Violin plot displayed levels of Spermidine, D-glucose, deoxyribose and Glutathione in SS-31 + aged oocytes compared with aged ones. G HMDB Primary pathways analysis displays that SS-31 treatment promote Glutathione metabolism. Compared with the aged group, red indicates that the metabolite content is significantly up-regulated in the SS-31 + aged group, whereas blue indicates that the metabolite content is significantly down-regulated in the SS-31 + aged group
